newsitem.title: USA: TJX Q2, H1 results better than expected. [CORRECTED 15:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: TJX Q2, H1 results better than expected. [CORRECTED 15:55 GMT]

text.p: TJX Cos Inc said Tuesday its second-quarter and first-half (corrects from second-half) results were better than it had anticipated amid strong sales at its off-price apparel retail chain stores like T.J. Maxx.

"Results are substantially ahead of what we anticipated," it said in a statement. "This superior performance was largely driven by better-than-expected comparable store sales gains which, on a consolidated basis, were up eight percent in the quarter."
TJX reported net income for the quarter at $0.29 per share on net sales of $1.7 billion, compared to $0.20 on $1.5 billion for the same period a year ago.
For the second half, it reported net income of $0.56 per share on $3.3 billion, against $0.37 on $3.0 billion.

"Our success was broadly spread throughout our geographic regions and merchandise categories. In addition, we managed our inventories extremely well, keeping exciting merchandise with great values flowing into our stores," it said.
